package experiment // import "github.com/TimLai666/coimnet/experiment"

func RunNav2D(ctx context.Context, c Nav2DConfig) (Nav2DReport, error)
    RunNav2D trains each policy for each seed with trainNav2D(ctx, p,
    c.Env, seed, c.Episodes) (demonstrations plus DAgger rollouts on
    nav2dTrainMap(seed, e)) and evaluates it; a failed run keeps its error and
    the others continue; ctx cancellation aborts. The report owns its Seeds and
    Policies independently of the caller.
